# Computational Social Science Projects

A collection of small projects exploring the intersection of network
science, computational methods, and social behavior.

## Projects

### [Wikipedia Trust Network](wikipedia-trust-network/)
Analysis of Wikipedia's admin vote network: centrality, community
detection, and what they reveal about trust structures.

### [Misinformation Spread Simulation](misinformation-spread-simulation/)
Agent-based simulation comparing how network structure (small-world vs.
scale-free) shapes the speed and pattern of belief spread.
